item.title: Bihar DISCOMs Issue Tender for 275 MW Rooftop Solar Under PM Surya Ghar Scheme
item.description: South Bihar Power Distribution Company Limited (SBPDCL), Bihar’s power distribution utility, has issued a tender seeking online bids from eligible and experienced agencies, firms, companies, and state or central government undertakings to develop grid-connected 275 MW rooftop solar projects. Bids are open until January 29, 2026. Bihar is among the states with one of the lowest installation levels under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana. item.title: UP’s Bundelkhand Now Flaunts 17,515 Acres of Land for Solar Projects
item.description: The Bundelkhand region of Uttar Pradesh is offering around 17,515 acres of land for hosting solar projects in the state. The state government has identified these land parcels as suitable for utility-scale, ground-mounted solar power projects. The Uttar Pradesh New and Renewable Energy Development Agency (UPNEDA) has issued a revised list of its land bank available for clean energy projects, primarily solar, in the region. item.title: Olectra Commissions Phase I of Hyderabad EV Plant with 2,500 Buses Annual Capacity
item.description: Olectra has recently operationalised its new Electric Vehicle (EV) Manufacturing Facility at Seetharampur, Hyderabad, Telangana. The company announced plans to set up the facility with an annual per-shift production capacity of 2,500 buses. item.title: MERC Allows C&I Consumer Simultaneous Benefits of Net Metering and Open Access
item.description: In another judgment related to rooftop solar connections for the Commercial & Industrial (C&I) segment, the Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission (MERC) has reiterated that net metering and open access can coexist in Maharashtra. item.title: Shakti Pumps Get Off-Grid Solar Pump Orders From MP, Haryana
item.description: Indian solar pump manufacturer Shakti Pumps has announced that it has secured a new solar pump order in Haryana. In a regulatory filing, the Indore-based company stated that it has received the order from the Haryana Renewable Energy Department (HAREDA). The award comprises an order for 792 solar water pumping systems for the state.
